_architecture_summary: Encoder: input→Linear(64,leaky)→Linear(32,identity)→tanh→latent z. Decoder: z→Linear(64,leaky)→Linear(output,identity)→reconstruct. BPTT with stateful LSTM cells.
_loss_function: MSE (mean squared error) on reconstructed audio time-series
_preprocessing: Window 256 (1s@256Hz), encodings: direct (passthrough), Poisson (spike rate), latency (time-to-first-spike). Normalized per-window [0,1].
_total_runs_breakdown: 9 total = 3 encodings × 3 repeats (seeds: 42,43,44). Single pass per encoding, no hyperparameter sweep.
_dataset_config: 500 train, 100 val (FSDD). 100 epochs max, early stop patience 20, lr 0.001, batch size 1.
_comment: LSTM-AE baseline: 9 runs (3 encodings × 3 repeats). Reproduces with LSTM+BPTT+MSE. 500/100 data. Est. ~30 min.

model.encoder_description: Input → LSTM(hidden=64) → Linear(64,leaky) → Linear(32,tanh projection) → latent z
model.decoder_description: Latent z → Linear(64,leaky) → LSTM(hidden=64) → Linear(output_dim,identity) → reconstruct
model.training_algorithm: BPTT (Backpropagation Through Time) with stateful LSTM cells
